guideTitle: The Best Desk Pads for a Home Office on a Small Budget
breadcrumbLabel: Best Desk Pads for Home Office
metaTitle: Best Desk Pads for Home Office: PU Leather, Felt and Decorative (2026)
metaDescription: We compared inexpensive home-office desk pads on material, size and style, from wipe-clean PU leather to felt and floral mats, all under $20 at the time of writing.
introParagraphs: A desk pad does three simple jobs at home: protects the desk from scratches and spills, gives the mouse a consistent surface, and softens the look of a hard desktop. Every pad here costs under $20 at the time of writing, so the choice is mainly about material, size and style.

PU leather wipes clean and suits a tidy, neutral desk. Felt feels warmer and quieter but absorbs spills. Printed and scalloped designs are about looks. Size matters most: measure the area for keyboard, mouse and laptop before ordering.
Several listings here are size or color variants from the same brands. Our comparison is based on published specifications and price position, not hands-on testing.

best-desk-pads-for-home-office-1.summary: A 23.6 x 13.7-inch waterproof PU leather pad with a non-slip back for about $10.
best-desk-pads-for-home-office-1.description:
The Aothia 23.6 x 13.7-inch pad is the sensible starting point for a small desk: waterproof PU leather that wipes clean, with a non-slip back, for about $10 at the time of writing.

It fits a laptop and mouse, or a compact keyboard and mouse.

It is smaller than most pads here; the larger Aothia variant costs about $4 more.
cons: Small for a full keyboard and mouse
best-desk-pads-for-home-office-1.skipIf: You use a full-size keyboard and mouse; choose a larger pad.

best-desk-pads-for-home-office-2.summary: A PU leather desk protector that doubles as a large mouse pad.
best-desk-pads-for-home-office-2.description:
The YSAGi is a PU leather desk protector that also works as a large mouse pad and wipes clean.

The listing does not give dimensions; YSAGi sells several sizes and colors, three of which appear in this guide at $10 to $14, so choose by size.
best-desk-pads-for-home-office-2.bestFor: Buyers who want a simple PU pad and will pick the size.
best-desk-pads-for-home-office-2.skipIf: You want stated dimensions; the Aothia and iCasso list theirs.

best-desk-pads-for-home-office-3.summary: A larger Aothia PU leather pad, about 15.7 inches deep, for keyboard, mouse and laptop.
best-desk-pads-for-home-office-3.description:
The larger Aothia is the pick for a full keyboard and mouse setup: the same waterproof PU leather and non-slip back as the compact version, about 15.7 inches deep according to the listing, for about $14 at the time of writing.

The listing's width is truncated, so confirm the exact size when ordering.
specs: Size: about 15.7" deep (width not clear in listing)
best-desk-pads-for-home-office-3.bestFor: Home desks with a full keyboard, mouse and laptop.
best-desk-pads-for-home-office-3.skipIf: Your desk is small; the compact Aothia fits better.

best-desk-pads-for-home-office-4.summary: Another YSAGi PU leather desk protector listing.
best-desk-pads-for-home-office-4.description:
This is another YSAGi PU leather desk protector listing with the same description, at about $14 at the time of writing, likely a different size or color.

Check the size before ordering.
best-desk-pads-for-home-office-4.bestFor: Buyers who want the YSAGi in this specific variant.
best-desk-pads-for-home-office-4.skipIf: The $10 YSAGi variant is the size you need.

best-desk-pads-for-home-office-5.summary: A 36 x 12-inch felt desk mat for a softer, warmer surface.
best-desk-pads-for-home-office-5.description:
The DAWNTREES is the felt option: a 36 x 12-inch mat that is softer and quieter than PU leather and gives a warmer look.

Felt absorbs liquids rather than repelling them, so spills need prompt attention.

At 12 inches deep it covers keyboard and mouse but not much more.
pros: Long enough for keyboard and mouse
best-desk-pads-for-home-office-5.bestFor: Desks where a soft, warm surface matters more than wipe-clean care.
best-desk-pads-for-home-office-5.skipIf: You often have drinks at the desk; a PU pad wipes clean.

best-desk-pads-for-home-office-6.summary: A 35.4 x 15.7-inch pink floral mat with a lycra surface.
best-desk-pads-for-home-office-6.description:
The iCasso floral mat is for a desk that doubles as decor: a 35.4 x 15.7-inch pink floral design with a lycra surface, large enough for keyboard, mouse and laptop.

It is the most expensive pad here at about $19 at the time of writing, and a fabric surface is less spill-resistant than PU.
best-desk-pads-for-home-office-6.skipIf: You want a neutral, wipe-clean pad.

best-desk-pads-for-home-office-7.summary: A $10 YSAGi PU leather desk protector variant.
best-desk-pads-for-home-office-7.description:
This YSAGi listing is another variant of the same PU leather desk protector, at about $10 at the time of writing.

It duplicates the other YSAGi entries; choose whichever variant matches your size and color.
best-desk-pads-for-home-office-7.bestFor: Budget buyers choosing a YSAGi size.

best-desk-pads-for-home-office-8.summary: A PU leather desk mat with scalloped piping edges.
best-desk-pads-for-home-office-8.description:
The Ralxion is the pick for a softer, playful look: a PU leather mat with scalloped piping around the edge, smooth enough for writing.

It costs about $14 at the time of writing. The listing describes a generous size but does not give dimensions.
best-desk-pads-for-home-office-8.bestFor: Home desks where a decorative edge fits the room.
best-desk-pads-for-home-office-8.skipIf: You want a plain, professional look.

buyingCriteria.explanation: PU leather wipes clean; felt and lycra feel softer but absorb spills.
Measure your keyboard, mouse and laptop area. Several listings here omit dimensions.
Neutral PU suits a work look; floral, felt and scalloped designs add character.
Non-slip backs help the pad stay in place.

faq.a: PU leather wipes clean and suits a neat look; felt is softer and quieter but absorbs spills.
Lay out your keyboard, mouse and laptop, measure, and add a little margin.

faq.q: Why are there several YSAGi and Aothia entries?
faq.a: They appear to be size or color variants of the same pads. Choose the variant that fits your desk.

faq.q: Can a desk pad replace a mouse pad?
faq.a: Yes. A large desk pad covers both keyboard and mouse.

bottomLine: For most home desks, an Aothia PU pad is the sensible choice: the compact size for small desks, the larger one for a full keyboard and mouse. The YSAGi pads are similar alternatives; pick by size.
The DAWNTREES felt mat suits anyone who prefers a soft surface, and the iCasso floral and Ralxion scalloped pads are for desks where style comes first.
